errors.text_span: 其余四个较小的切片分别对应“具备两类语体的同义词簇”中仅具备口语词和通用语词（4.7%）、仅具备口语词和书面语词（5.0%）、仅具备通用语词和书面语词（10.2%）以及“具备一类语体的同义词簇”中仅具备口语词（1.5%）、仅具备通用语词（20.8%）、仅具备书面语词（41.4%）
errors.evidence: The inner-ring percentages do match the visible labels, but the description misassigns the subgroup structure: 4.7%, 5.0%, and 10.2% are not all subcategories of the 51.1% outer slice, and 1.5%, 20.8%, and 41.4% are not all subcategories of the 32.5% outer slice in the way stated.

The description identifies the chart as showing distribution of synonym-cluster register categories, but it does not explicitly state the visible chart title/purpose as the captioned topic: '《词表》中同义词簇语体差异情况'.
